categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu HHCK Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor packaging materials, specifically epoxy molding compounds (EMC) and electronic adhesives. These products serve the semiconductor packaging and board-level assembly sectors, covering both traditional and advanced packaging technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced formulation and production processes for epoxy molding compounds and electronic adhesives, including continuous molding, low-stress technology, high reliability, warpage control, high thermal conductivity, and high voltage resistance. It employs automated and intelligent production lines, with proprietary granular powder production equipment to meet advanced packaging requirements such as FOWLP and FOPLP.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading semiconductor packaging companies such as JCET, TFME, Huatian Technology, Galaxy Microsystems, Yangjie Technology, and Fuman Microelectronics. The products are used in semiconductor chip packaging, automotive electronics, photovoltaic modules, and other industrial assembly applications, serving domestic and international semiconductor markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with production and sales bases extending to regions including Lianyungang, and plans to expand into South Korea and Malaysia through acquisitions. Its sales network covers East China, Southwest China, South China, and other regions domestically.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu HHCK operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in the production of key semiconductor packaging materials that are supplied to downstream semiconductor packaging and testing companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in advanced semiconductor packaging materials, focusing on developing products for emerging packaging technologies such as QFN, BGA, SiP, WLP, and automotive-grade materials. It invests heavily in automation, intelligent manufacturing, and expanding its R&D capabilities, including new equipment for simulation and testing to accelerate product development and industrialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the direct sale of semiconductor packaging materials, including epoxy molding compounds and electronic adhesives, to semiconductor packaging manufacturers and industrial assembly customers. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income from financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with foreign-dominated suppliers in the high-end semiconductor packaging materials market but has established a leading position domestically, especially in traditional packaging materials. It is recognized as a key domestic player advancing the localization and substitution of imported materials, with growing market share in advanced packaging segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 331.6 million, a 17.23% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 40.06 million, up 26.63%. Total assets reached RMB 1.4 billion, with steady growth in profitability and R&D investment accounting for nearly 8% of revenue. The company maintains a stable financial position with ongoing capacity expansion and strategic acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu HHCK emphasizes its comprehensive product portfolio covering traditional and advanced semiconductor packaging materials, strong R&D capabilities, and rapid customer service response. Its proprietary technologies enable high-performance, low-stress, and high-reliability materials tailored to evolving packaging technologies, supporting domestic semiconductor industry self-sufficiency and reducing reliance on foreign suppliers.
